releases.body:
Thinking orbs.

Every session that is actually doing something now carries a small orb instead of a plain dot: the closed bar shows one for the session it is also showing the words of, and every row of the open panel shows its own. The orb names the activity — thinking, writing, searching, running code — so a web search no longer looks like a shell command.

Orbs come from [Thinking orbs](https://libraries.dev/orbs) by Jakub Antalik, MIT.

And a fix for the closed bar stretching while the agent talks: its length no longer follows the words, they fill it from under the dot and are cut at the bottom, so the bar keeps still instead of growing and shrinking around its middle.

One appearance button that cycles light, dark and system.

And a fix for the island closing itself the moment it opened to ask for a permission: the window never holds focus, so the app taking focus back collapsed it mid-question. An island with a pending approval now stays put until it is answered. The bottom bar also reads on the warning background.
The first island: a live tab for every OpenCode session, streamed answers, in-place approvals and a bar you can size.
